status.en: 7 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 42% fewer than the week before, most of them in Baghdad, Kirkuk and Fallujah.
status.nb: 7 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 42 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Baghdad, Kirkuk og Fallujah.

summary.en: Iraqi authorities arrested several suspected smugglers tied to a boat sinking that killed three children in Erbil and detained another smuggling suspect in a separate case, while Kurdish security forces also made a related arrest. Turkish forces partially withdrew from the Zilkan camp in Nineveh and a drug squad in Kirkuk dismantled a cross-border trafficking ring. A Jewish museum opened in Baghdad and Iran's parliament speaker met Iraqi militia leaders, prompting US officials to state readiness to assist Erbil after a recent missile strike. The UCDP recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Irakiske myndigheter arresterte flere mistenkte smuglere knyttet til en båtforlis som drepte tre barn i Erbil, og fengslet en annen smugler i en separat sak, mens kurdiske sikkerhetsstyrker også foretok en relatert arrestasjon. Tyrkiske styrker trakk seg delvis tilbake fra Zilkan-leiren i Nineveh, og en narkotikagruppe i Kirkuk demonterte et grenseoverskridende smuglernettverk. Et jødisk museum åpnet i Bagdad, og Irans parlamentspresident møtte irakiske militsledere, noe som fikk amerikanske tjenestemenn til å uttale at de er klare til å bistå Erbil etter et nylig missilangrep. UCDP registrerte 396 kamprelaterte dødsfall i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Iraqi conflict
background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
